# Hazmat Suit
Four lead-lined rubber pieces. The full suit lets only 5% of the radiation from outside through; fewer pieces protect in part (hood 15%, suit 40%, trousers 30%, boots 15% of that). It doesn't help with what you carry: that's inside the suit with you.
# Lead Box
Nine slots: nothing radioactive inside it is felt, wherever the box is. Use it in your main hand to open it.

# Shielding blocks
- Lead Block and Lead Bricks: 10% through.
- Block of Depleted Uranium: 5%, the best (and itself a little radioactive).
- Concrete Shielding (concrete cast round steel rebar): 25%; plain concrete 30%.
Depleted Uranium can stand in for lead in the Lead Box, Hazmat Suit and Lead Bricks.
